items.stem: Explain any four reasons why adjustments are needed in final accounts.
items.answer: (i) To follow the matching concept: Revenues and expenses of the year are matched. (ii) To follow the accrual basis: Incomes earned and expenses incurred are recorded whether or not received or paid. (iii) To show the true profit: Profit is neither overstated nor understated. (iv) To show the true financial position: Outstanding, prepaid and accrued items appear in the balance sheet.
items.markingKey: Any four points, 1½ marks each (heading and explanation): (i) To follow the matching concept: Revenues and expenses of the year are matched. (ii) To follow the accrual basis: Incomes earned and expenses incurred are recorded whether or not received or paid. (iii) To show the true profit: Profit is neither overstated nor understated. (iv) To show the true financial position: Outstanding, prepaid and accrued items appear in the balance sheet.

items.stem: Trial balance of Bose Brothers: debtors ₹78,000, bad debts ₹7,500, provision for doubtful debts (old) ₹13,000. items.answer: Charged ₹3,200; net debtors ₹69,300
items.markingKey: New provision = 10% of (₹78,000 − ₹1,000) = ₹7,700. P&L charge = bad debts ₹7,500 + further ₹1,000 + new provision ₹7,700 − old provision ₹13,000 = ₹3,200. Debtors ₹78,000 − ₹1,000 − ₹7,700 = ₹69,300.
